description: This file contains an async function `listOrganizations` that fetches a list of organizations (tenants) for the current user from the API endpoint `/session/tenants`. It normalizes various possible data structures and keys returned from the API, sorts the resulting list by name and ID, and exposes the function as part of the default export.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches, normalizes, sorts, and returns a list of organization objects accessible to the current user.
